en: Matter, as we know it; Atoms, stars and galaxies, planets and trees, rocks and us.
zh: 我們所熟知的物質：原子、恆星、星系、行星、樹、岩石，以及我們。

en: This matter accounts for less than 5% of the known universe.
zh: 這些物質佔整個宇宙不到５%。

en: About 25% is dark matter; and 70% is dark energy.
zh: 在整個宇宙中，大約２５%是暗物質，７０%是暗能量。

en: Both of which are invisible.
zh: 暗物質與暗能量都無法被觀測到。

en: This is kind of strange because it suggests that everything we experience is really only a tiny fraction of reality.
zh: 這聽起來有點奇怪，這表示我們所接觸到的世界只佔了極其微小的部分。

en: But it gets worse.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: We really have no clue what dark matter and energy are, or how they work.
zh: 更糟糕的是，我們對暗物質與暗能量究竟是什麼、如何運作毫無頭緒更糟糕的是，我們對暗物質與暗能量究竟是什麼、如何運作毫無頭緒

en: We are pretty sure they exist though.
zh: 我們非常確定它們是存在的。至於，為什麼我們知道它們存在呢？

en: So, what do we know?
zh: 我們非常確定它們是存在的。至於，為什麼我們知道它們存在呢？

en: Dark matter is the stuff that makes it possible for galaxies to exist.
zh: 暗物質使星系穩定存在

en: When we calculated why the universe is structured the way it is,
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: it quickly became clear that there's just not enough normal matter.
zh: 我們開始分析宇宙的結構時，發現能被觀測的"普通物質"並不足以令宇宙維持穩定存在。

en: The gravity of the visible matter is not strong enough to form galaxies and complex structures.
zh: 來自"普通物質"的重力不足以形成星系這樣的複雜結構，恆星間會更為鬆散，並四處散佈，

en: The stars would more likely be scattered all over the place and not form galaxies.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: So, we know there is something else inside and around them.
zh: 這將導致星系無法形成。因此，我們確信一定有某種東西在維繫星系的結構。

notes.zh: Can I get you anything else?：餐廳服務生標準詢問句
notes.example: Can I get you anything else, like water?

en: Something that doesn't emit or reflect light.
zh: 某種東西，它不發射光，也不反射光

en: Something dark...
zh: 所以稱作「暗」。

en: but besides being able to calculate the existence of dark matter, we can see it... kind of.
zh: 除了能計算到暗物質的存在以外，

en: Places with a high concentration of dark matter bend light passing near by.
zh: 我們還能看到它的微小跡象。高濃度暗物質的地方會使經過它的光線扭曲。

en: So we know there's something there that interacts with gravity.
zh: 因此我們確信有東西在那兒，並且會與重力作用。

en: Right now, we have more ideas about what dark energy is not, than what it is!
zh: 現在，對於暗物質(旁白口誤成暗能量)是什麼有進一步認識，那麼它究竟是什麼？

en: We know dark matter is not just clouds of normal matter without stars, because it would emit particles we could detect.
zh: 我們知道暗物質並非一團無光源的普通物質，因為普通物質會放射出我們能觀測到的粒子。

en: Dark matter is not anti-matter, because anti-matter produces unique gamma rays when it reacts with normal matter.
zh: 暗物質也不是"反"物質，因為反物質會與普通物質反應，並放出特殊的γ射線。

en: Dark matter is also not made up of black holes, very compact objects that violently affect their surroundings,
zh: 暗物質也不是由黑洞所構成。黑洞是種緊密的物體，且會劇烈影響周圍環境，但是暗物質似乎是零星散布在整個宇宙。

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

en: while dark matter seems to be scattered all over the place.
zh: 黑洞是種緊密的物體，且會劇烈影響周圍環境，但是暗物質似乎是零星散布在整個宇宙。

en: Basically, we only know 3 things for sure; 1. Something is out there.
zh: 基本上，我們目前對於暗物質只能確定三件事：一、有東西就在那裡。

en: 2. It interacts with gravity.
zh: 二、它會與重力作用。

en: 3. There is a lot of it.
zh: 三、它們有很多很多。

en: Dark matter is probably made up of a complicated exotic particle that doesn't interact with light and matter in a way we expect,
zh: 暗物質有可能是由某種複雜又特殊的粒子組成，這種粒子不會與光、普通物質反應

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

en: but right now, we just don't know.
zh: 但目前我們真的不瞭解它到底是什麼。

en: Dark energy is even more strange and mysterious.
zh: 暗能量又更奇怪與神祕：

en: We can't detect it, we can't measure it and we can't taste it.
zh: 我們無法檢測它、無法測量它、無法觸碰它。

en: But we do see its effects very clearly.
zh: 帶我們卻能非常清晰地看到它造成的影響：

en: In 1929, Edward Hubble examined how the wavelength of light emitted by distant galaxies, shifts towards the red end
zh: 1929年，愛德溫·哈伯透過研究遙遠星系發出的光的波長，

en: of the electromagnetic spectrum as it travels through the space.
zh: 發現光經過宇宙後出現紅移現象。

en: He found that fainter, more distant galaxies showed a large degree of red shift; closer galaxies, not so much.
zh: 哈伯發現較黯淡、較遙遠的星系會出現較大的紅移。距離近些的星系則出現紅移的幅度則小些。

en: Hubble determined that this was because the universe itself is expanding.
zh: 哈伯肯定地認為會出現紅移現象是因為宇宙正在膨脹，

en: The red shift occurs, because the wavelengths of light are stretched as the universe expands.
zh: 紅移的出現，是因為光的波長隨宇宙膨脹而被拉伸。

en: More recent discoveries have shown that, the expansion of the universe is accelerating.
zh: 近幾年的研究報告顯示宇宙的膨脹正在加速。

en: Before that, it was thougth that the pull of gravity would cause the expansion to
zh: 在此之前，人們認為重力將使宇宙膨脹減緩，甚至塌縮回一個點。

en: either slow down or even retract and collapse in on itself at some point.
zh: 在此之前，人們認為重力將使宇宙膨脹減緩，甚至塌縮回一個點。

en: Space doesn't change its properties as it expands; there's just more of it.
zh: 空間並沒有因為膨脹而改變它的性質。宇宙膨脹就只是讓空間變更多！

en: New space is constantly created everywhere, galaxies are tight bound clusters of stuff held together by gravity
zh: 年輕的新空間一直在宇宙所有地方新生。星系是一種透過重力緊密集群的東西。

notes.zh: come together：順利成形、水到渠成
notes.example: Everything came together right before the deadline.

en: so we don't experience this expansion in our daily lives.
zh: 因此身處星系中的我們不會感受到宇宙膨脹，但我們仍能在任何地方看到膨脹的影響。

en: But we see it everywhere around us.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: Wherever there is empty space in the universe, more is forming every second.
zh: 無論何處，宇宙中隨時都有新的空間(空白空間)在形成

notes.zh: just need a second：請稍等我們一下
notes.example: Sorry, we just need a second to check the menu.

en: So, dark energy seems to be some kind of energy intrinsic to empty space.
zh: 因此，暗能量似乎是某種空白空間裡固有的能量。

en: Energy that is stronger than anything else we know and it keeps getting stronger as time passes by.
zh: 暗能量，比任何東西都要強大而且日益增強。

notes.zh: Can I get you anything else?：餐廳服務生標準詢問句
notes.example: Can I get you anything else, like water?

en: Empty space has more energy than everything else in the universe combined.
zh: 空白空間中的能量比起宇宙其他所有東西的總和還要多

notes.zh: Can I get you anything else?：餐廳服務生標準詢問句
notes.example: Can I get you anything else, like water?

en: We have multiple ideas about what dark energy might be.
zh: 我們對於暗能量可能是什麼有多種猜測。

en: One idea is, the dark energy is not a thing, but just a property of space.
zh: 一種猜測是暗能量並非某種事物，它只是空間的特性。

en: Empty space is not nothing, it has its own energy.
zh: 空白空間並非"虛無"，它擁有自己的能量。

en: It can generate more space and is quite active.
zh: 空白空間可以產生更多空間，而且相當活躍。

en: So, as the universe expands, it could be that just more and more space
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: appears to fill the gaps and this leads to a faster expanding universe.
zh: 因此當宇宙在膨脹時，空白空間使更多空間出現並填補缺口，造成宇宙加速膨脹。

en: This idea is close to an idea that Einstein had back in 1917, of the concept of a cosmological constant,
zh: 這個猜測接近愛因斯坦在1917年對宇宙常數概念的想法。

en: a force that counteracted the force of gravity.
zh: 有一種力與重力對抗著。

en: The only problem is, that when we tried to calculate the amount of this energy
zh: 唯一的問題是，當我們嘗試這樣計算暗能量的多寡時，會出現詭異的結果，留下更多困惑與謎題。

en: the result was so wrong and weird, that it only added to the confusion.
zh: 唯一的問題是，當我們嘗試這樣計算暗能量的多寡時，會出現詭異的結果，留下更多困惑與謎題。

notes.zh: don't take this the wrong way：別誤會我的意思（說真話前超實用緩衝句）
notes.example: Don't take this the wrong way, but the second version reads better.

en: Another idea is, that empty space is actually full of temporary, virtual particles that spontaneously and continually
zh: 另一種猜測是空白空間充斥著一種暫時且虛無飄渺的粒子，它會不斷從一無所有形成，然後再消失回一無所有。

notes.example: Actually, we're just looking around for now.

en: form from nothing and then dissapear into nothing again.
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: The energy form those particles could be dark energy.
zh: 這些粒子的能量可能就是暗能量。

en: Or maybe dark energy is an unknown kind of dynamic energy fluid or field
zh: 或是另一種猜測：暗能量是種未知的動態能量流體或是力場，它滲入了整個宇宙。

en: which permeates the entire universe, but somehow has the opposite effect on the universe than normal energy and matter.
zh: 但不知何故，它有與普通物質、普通能量相反的效果。

en: But if it exists, we don't know how and where or how we could detect it.
zh: 如果真是如此，我們並不知道怎麼、在哪探測到它。

en: So there are still a lot of questions to answer.
zh: 所以目前還有許多問題待解決。

en: Our theories about dark matter and dark energy are still just that; theories.
zh: 我們關於暗物質、暗能量的理論仍處於理論階段。

en: On one hand, this is kind of frustrating, on the other hand this is frontier science making it very exciting.
zh: 一方面而言，這挺令人洩氣的；另一方面，因為這是最前端的科學，因此使人興奮，

en: It shows us that no matter how much we feel we're on top of things, we are still very much apes with smartphones, on a tiny
zh: 這代表著無論我們多麼認為自己是萬物之王，但其實只是活在宇宙中脆弱小島並使用智慧型手機的猿人。因此，去仰望這片天空吧！去追尋宇宙運行的真理！

en: fragile island in space looking into the sky wondering how our universe works
zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）

en: There is so much left to learn, and that is awesome.
zh: 有太多東西等著我們去知道並學習。而且這些東西令人驚嘆！

en: This video is supported by the Australian Academy of Science, which promotes and supports excellence in science.
zh: 本影片由澳洲科學院(AAS)支援合作。 AAS是一推廣支持卓越科學研究的機構。

en: Learn more about this topic and others like it at nova.org.au.
zh: 想瞭解更多關於本主題及其他類似內容請上"nova.org.au"

en: It was a blast of work with them so go check out their site.
zh: 與NOVA.org一起工作超讚的，所以快去看他們網站吧！

en: Our videos are also made possible by your support on patreon.com,
zh: 本影片也因為你在"patreon.com"的贊助而成為可能。

notes.zh: you made it!：你成功辦到了／準時趕上了！
notes.example: I'm so glad you made it before the rain started.

zh: 若你想贊助我們並成為Kurzgesagt鳥大軍的成員之一，快去patreon的網頁吧！

zh: （對照上方英文字幕跟讀）
